integrity: The proof of the new classification and orbit series is written out; finite exact checks corroborate only bounded cases. Source attribution and cited limitations are explicit.
scientific_limitations: Classification restricted to nonzero zero-sum root twists; stable tangent and Kähler–Einstein characterizations credited to Wuebben. Isomorphism depends on standard maximal-torus conjugacy. Other families and full algebraic automorphism groups not classified; no claim of independent audit or absolute historical priority.
title: Isomorphism rigidity, fan symmetries, and asymptotic Kähler–Einstein scarcity for root-twisted toric Fano fibrations
